summary: Flaky test ExecuteWorkflowAsync_HistoryInfo_IsAccurate occasionally fails with a history length mismatch, reporting only 8 events when 50+ events were sent. The test flake suggests a race condition or timing issue in workflow history tracking.
userImpact: Intermittent test failures block CI/CD pipelines and reduce confidence in the .NET SDK reliability.
keyQuote: We sent at least 50 events but history length said it was only 8
